decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet remains a strong expression of the firm's craftsmanship and premium-material positioning, so despite its niche appeal it is worth retaining longer.
The corner bench fits naturally into the firm's residential, hospitality and project-furnishing portfolio, making continued marketing more likely than withdrawal.
After already removing two related rug launches, this low-pile carpet can serve as the streamlined surviving offer in the category, though accessories still face some assortment review risk.
The swivel shell chair line aligns very well with the firm's furniture core and its focus on flexible contemporary living and working environments, so it is unlikely to be dropped soon.
